not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested Hellknight discipline.

brand.name: Brand
description: ::ab{title="&L&Brand (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Pyre›" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can use ‹spell/mark of justice› as a spell-like ability."}

call_armor.name: Call Armor
description: ::ab{title="&L&Call Armor (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xm icon=def move="The Hellknight can cause her armor to instantly appear on her body. Alternatively, she can dismiss it as a move action, causing it to vanish. (Doing either of these counts as one use of this discipline.)~~~Where the armor appears from or vanishes to can be anywhere the Hellknight designates, but it must be a place the Hellknight has seen on the same plane of existence where she is, or be in an extradimensional space she controls, such as a bag of holding." special="This armor is a specific suit of ‹eq-armor/Hellknight plate› that the Hellknight designates when she selects this discipline. The Hellknight can attune this ability to a new set of armor, but doing so takes 1 week."}

censor.name: Censor
description: ::ab{title="&L&Censor (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Rack›" order=xa icon=lower ability="When the Hellknight uses *smite chaos* on a creature, he can strike the creature mute for 1d4 rounds unless it makes a successful Will save. A mute creature cannot speak, nor can it cast spells that have verbal components or use language-dependant effects."}

command.name: Command
description: ::ab{title="&L&Command (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can use ‹spell/greater command› as a spell-like ability, using her character level as her caster level."}

dispel_chaos.name: Dispel Chaos
description: ::ab{title="&L&Dispel Chaos (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can use ‹spell/dispel chaos› as a spell-like ability, using her character level as her caster level."}

favored_quarry.name: Favored Quarry
description: ::ab{title="&L&Favored Quarry (Ex)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xcp icon=boost choice="The Hellknight chooses a creature type from the ranger ‹ability/favored enemy› table (usually humanoid with a specific subtype, but this is not required)." passive="The Hellknight gains a +2 bonus on Bluff, Intimidate, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creatures of her selected type. She can also attempt Knowledge skill checks untrained to identify those creatures." special="Each time the Hellknight chooses an additional discipline, this bonus increases by 2 (to a potential maximum of +6 at 9th level)."}

fearsomeness.name: Fearsomeness
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fearsomeness (Ex)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=lower ability="A Hellknight who uses the Intimidate skill to cause a creature within 10 feet to become ‹misc/shaken› can instead cause that creature to become ‹misc/frightened›."}

invoke_glyph.name: Invoke Glyph
description: ::ab{title="&L&Invoke Glyph (Sp and Ex)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Glyph›" order=xap icon=magic-def ability="The Hellknight can use ‹spell/glyph of warding› as a spell-like ability. While this ability does not require an expensive material component, a single Hellknight can maintain only one *glyph of warding* at a time; if he uses this spell-like ability a second time, the previously created *glyph of warding* vanishes." passive="The Hellknight gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against *glyph of warding* or ‹main/symbol spells›."}

mental_intrusion.name: Mental Intrusion
description: ::ab{title="&L&Mental Intrusion (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can use ‹spell/telepathy› as a spell-like ability, using her character level as her caster level."}

onslaught.name: Onslaught
description: ::ab{title="&L&Onslaught (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Nail›" order=xf icon=boost free="Once per day, a Hellknight increases his base speed by +10 feet and gains a +4 bonus to his Strength for 1 round. If the Hellknight is mounted, these bonuses also apply to his mount."}

pentamic_faith.name: Pentamic Faith
description: ::ab{title="&L&Pentamic Faith (Ex)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Godclaw›" order=xca icon=boost choice="This ability allows the Hellknight to select one of the following domains: ‹domain/Artifice›, ‹domain/Glory›, ‹domain/Knowledge›, ‹domain/Law›, ‹domain/Magic›, ‹domain/Nobility›, ‹domain/Protection›, ‹domain/Rune›, ‹domain/Strength›, ‹domain/Travel›, and ‹domain/War›." ability="The Hellknight gains all of the granted powers (but not domain spells) of that domain, treating his Hellknight levels as cleric levels to determine what domain abilities he has access to." prereq="Must be of the *Order of the Godclaw.*"}

seek_the_taken.name: Seek the Taken
description: ::ab{title="&L&Seek the Taken&FN&" order=xa xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Torrent›" hl=x~a icon=magic ability="When a member of the *Order of the Torrent* becomes a 3rd-level Hellknight, he gains his first discipline: *seek the taken.* This enables the Hellknight to use an ‹feat/enlarged› ‹spell/locate creature› as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to his total character level." special="When an *Order of the Torrent* Hellknight gains his third discipline, he cannot choose the ‹hkdiscipline/summon devil› discipline."}

shackle.name: Shackle
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shackle (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Chain›" order=xa icon=lower ability="When the Hellknight uses *smite chaos* on a creature, he can impede its mobility. The creature can negate this effect with a Will save; otherwise, it is affected as if by a ‹spell/slow› spell for 1d4 rounds."}

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow Step (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can use ‹feat/enlarged› ‹spell/shadow step› as a spell-like ability, as if the Enlarge Spell metamagic feat were applied to the spell, using her character level as her caster level."}

summon_devil.name: Summon Devil
description: ::ab{title="&L&Summon Devil (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Gate›" prereq="Cannot be in the ‹hkorder/Order of the Torrent›" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight may use ‹spell/summon monster V› as a spell-like ability to summon 1 ‹monster/bearded devil›." imp6="This spell-like ability is replaced by ‹spell/summon monster VI›, allowing him to summon 1d3 bearded devils, or 1 ‹monster/erinyes›." imp9="This spell-like ability is replaced by ‹spell/summon monster VII›, allowing him to summon 1d4+1 bearded devils, 1d3 erinyes, or 1 ‹monster/bone devil›."}

summon_servant_of_law.name: Summon Servant of Law
description: ::ab{title="&L&Summon Servant of Law (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can summon a creature or creatures to help her, as if using a ‹spell/summon monster› spell." imp3="She can summon 1d3 ‹monster/hell hound«s›." imp6="She can summon 1d3 ‹template/advanced› hell hounds or one ‹monster/axiomite›." imp9="She can summon 1d4+1 hell hounds, 1d3 axiomites, or one ‹monster/zelekhut« inevitable›."}

trace.name: Trace
description: ::ab{title="&L&Trace (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can study a single personal belonging of a creature for 1 minute, after which she knows the general direction of the creature's current location as long as it is within 1 mile and on the same plane. She also learns the direction the creature is currently moving, if any. This effect lasts for 10 minutes per character level." special="An object can be used as the focus for this ability only once. For the purposes of this ability, a &quot&personal belonging&quot& is any object a creature owned or carried with it for more than a week.~~~If the target is under the effects of ‹spell/nondetection› or a similar spell or effect, or is on a different plane, this ability gives no result."}

tracker.name: Tracker
description: ::ab{title="&L&Tracker (Sp)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=magic ability="The Hellknight can summon a creature to aid him, either in battle or to track an enemy, as if using a ‹spell/summon monster› spell, save that the summoned creature lingers for 1 hour before vanishing." imp6="The Hellknight can summon either an ‹monster/eagle›, a ‹monster/riding dog›, a ‹monster/wolf›, or a ‹monster/leopard›." imp9="The Hellknight can instead opt to summon a ‹monster/dire wolf› or a ‹monster/hell hound›."}

versatile_intimidation.name: Versatile Intimidation
description: ::ab{title="&L&Versatile Intimidation (Ex)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xa icon=boost ability="The Hellknight can use Intimidate to reproduce the effects of another Charisma-based skill. Choose one of the following: Bluff, Diplomacy, Handle Animal, or Perform (oratory). Each time the Hellknight wishes to use that skill, she can attempt an Intimidate check and treat it as if it were a check of the desired type." imp9="The Hellknight can choose an additional skill from the list above and use Intimidate to reproduce its effects."}

vigilance.name: Vigilance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Vigilance (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="‹hkorder/Order of the Scourge›" order=xar icon=power ability="The Hellknight gains low-light vision (this effect is constant)." fullround="The Hellknight can see through up to 5 feet of stone, wood, or similar barriers as if they didn't exist. Metal or denser barriers block this effect. Each use of this ability lasts as long as the Hellknight concentrates, up to a number of rounds equal to the Hellknight's level."}

wrack.name: Wrack
description: ::ab{title="&L&Wrack (Su)&FN&" hl=x xOrder="Any order" order=xs icon=touch standard="The Hellknight may make a touch attack to cause a creature to suffer incredible pain. The creature touched takes 1d6 points of damage + the Hellknight's Charisma modifier, and must make a Will save to avoid being ‹misc/staggered› for 1d4 rounds."}
